## Import and tidy the manual ID dataset
```{r}
mdf <- read_csv("C:/Users/apmc/OneDrive - Norwegian University of Life Sciences/BatLab Norway/Projects/CoastalMonitoring/Analyses/Outputs/Reed/CombineCSVs_Report2026_2026-11-11/CM_manualIDs_allavailable_subsets.csv")

dim(mdf)
# 89556    14
names(mdf)
str(mdf)

MDF <- mdf |> 
  dplyr::select(-1) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    autoid = factor(autoid),
    manualid = factor(manualid), 
    analyst = factor(analyst), 
    site = factor(site),
    newauto = factor(newauto),
    DATE = as.Date(DATE), 
    DATE.12 = as.Date(DATE.12), 
    TIME = as.character(TIME), 
    TIME.12 = as.character(TIME.12))  

summary(MDF)
names(MDF)

# Looking good! 

## Get a list of the files that have been manually verified 
mfiles <- unique(MDF$filename)
# 70354 files 
head(mfiles)
# Good 

## simplified MDF for merging the manualIDs and filenames only to another dataset
MDF1 <- MDF |> select(c(filename, manualid))
dim(MDF1)
# 89556     2 - good! 
## Might run into some issues with the multiple taxa passes, but lets circle back to that 

```

## Import and clean/combine autoid datasets 
```{r}

######################################################################
## 2024 DATASET ##
CM24 <- read_csv("C:/Users/apmc/OneDrive - Norwegian University of Life Sciences/BatLab Norway/Projects/CoastalMonitoring/Analyses/Data 2024-2026/2024/cm_2024_night.csv")
dim(CM24)
# 3097455      21

# I am going to remove noise autoids from all of these for now just make things more manageable 
names(CM24)
noise <- CM24 |> filter(autoid == "Noise") 
nrow(noise)
# 1034350 noise recordings to be removed 

cm24 <- CM24 |> 
  select(c(filename, 
            DATE, TIME, HOUR, 
            DATE.12, TIME.12, HOUR.12, 
            autoid, MATCH.RATIO, Site)) |> 
  rename(site = Site)|> 
  mutate(DATE.12 = as.Date(DATE.12), 
         TIME.12 = as.character(TIME.12), 
         TIME = as.character(TIME), 
         autoid = factor(autoid),
         site = factor(site)) |> 
  filter(autoid != "Noise") |> droplevels()

dim(cm24)
# 2063105      10

nrow(CM24) - nrow(cm24)
# 1034350 - good! 1034350 noise recordings removed

summary(cm24)
names(cm24)
 # [1] "filename"    "DATE"        "TIME"        "HOUR"        "DATE.12"     "TIME.12"    
 # [7] "HOUR.12"     "autoid"      "MATCH.RATIO" "site"       

######################################################################
## 2025 DATASET ##




```
